text:
𝗕𝗔𝗡𝗚𝗟𝗔𝗗𝗘𝗦𝗛 𝟰𝟬𝟬 𝗔𝗟𝗟 𝗢𝗨𝗧! 🇧🇩

Litton Das made 120; Rabada took 5 wickets.
Hasan Mahmud removed Markram, SA 18/1 at lunch on Day 2 at the Wanderers.

Can SA pass 400? 👇

#SAvBAN #Cricket

👉 Litton Das ne 120 (179 balls) banaye, apna 8th Test ton
👉 Rabada ko 5 wickets mile
👉 Hasan Mahmud ne Markram ko 5 par nipta diya, SA lunch tak 18/1

Kya South Africa 400 paar kar paayega? Comment karo 👇

#CricketKiBaat #SAvBAN #TestCricket
